title: 针对 ChainStream 的链上数据仓库（3 个链组中的 27 个立方体：EVM、Solana、
description: Execute flexible GraphQL queries against ChainStream's on-chain data warehouse (27 cubes in 3 chain groups: EVM, Solana, Trading). Use when user needs custom analytics beyond standard REST/MCP — cross-cube JOINs, custom aggregations, complex WHERE filters, time-series analysis, or SQL-level flexibility on blockchain data. Supports x402/MPP auto-payment. Keywords: GraphQL, query, cube, DEXTrades, DEXTradeByTokens, Pairs, aggregation, join, on-chain analytics, custom query.
